seo.title: Materials — what's in a Lore pad or tampon | Lore Organics
seo.description: Everything in a Lore pad or tampon, listed in plain words: GOTS-certified organic cotton, made in Europe, dermatologically and gynecologically tested.

heading: Materials.
intro: Everything in a Lore pad or tampon, listed in plain words. If it touches you, you should know what it is.
line: Every material, every product, listed here and on the pack. Because you have the right to know.
imageAlt: A box of Lore Organics pads in daylight
packaging: All packaging is FSC-certified, sourced from responsibly managed forests.
certification: Our cotton is GOTS certified. The Global Organic Textile Standard covers how it's grown and processed, including fair wages, safe working conditions and no child labor.
testing: Our pads and tampons are dermatologically tested and gynecologically tested. Because your period is enough to deal with already.
